_comment: The caller personas: what each is called, how it is described to a reader,
and where its runs are stored. Coval owns what a persona does (noise,
speakerphone, cell audio); this file owns how we present it and which
dataset id its conversations land under. Coval ids live in Terraform.
personas: one entry per slug. The slug is an identifier and never changes;
the label is display text and may. order is the x-axis position, clean first.
bindings: per family, which personas run and which dataset id each encodes.
anchor names the metric every optional metric's population must match:
latency (V2V) when the audio is clean, judge (instruction following) when it
is not, because noise sits in the lane VAD uses for turn boundaries.

clean.label: Clean
clean.description: The baseline caller: a clear voice with no background noise, no audio degradation and no interruptions.

low.label: Low
low.description: The same caller in a busy office, with steady background chatter and keyboard noise behind the voice.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Office noise plus a speakerphone: the caller's voice arrives slightly hollow and distant, as from a desk phone on speaker.

hard.label: Hard
hard.description: Office noise over a poor mobile connection: the voice drops in and out, with the compression artefacts of a weak cell signal.

extra_hard.label: Extra hard
extra_hard.description: Office noise plus a bad speakerphone: heavy room echo and muffling on top of the background chatter, the hardest audio in the set.
